tools.name: find_birth_place
tools.description: Search a city or town by name and get coordinates and time zone for a birth chart. Returns several matches when the name is ambiguous (e.g. Donetsk in Ukraine and in Russia).

tools.name: calculate_natal_chart
tools.description: Vedic (sidereal, Lahiri) birth chart (Rashi, D1): ascendant, planets with signs, degrees, whole-sign houses, nakshatras and padas, dignity, Jaimini chara karakas, and the current Vimshottari dasha periods with dates. Includes a link to the full interactive chart.

tools.name: get_dasha_timeline
tools.description: Upcoming Vimshottari periods for a birth chart: the current mahadasha/antardasha/pratyantardasha and the dates when the next antardasha and pratyantardasha periods begin.

tools.name: get_period_email_alerts
tools.description: How the user can get an email when a new dasha period starts in their chart, with a personal interpretation. Returns a sign-up link with the chart pre-filled. Nothing is sent or created by this tool; the user signs up on the website themselves.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "astro-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_period_email_alerts · Public sink: get_period_email_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_period_email_alerts · Public sink: get_period_email_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
